//.fmt: Formats everything: dprint (dprint.json), then the <script> and <style> blocks of every .svelte file, which dprint's markup plugin leaves alone.
//.lint: oxlint (.oxlintrc.json): deno lint's recommended rules where oxlint has them, plus its correctness category.
//.check: Type-checks the scripts outside any package: images/ and .ryph/ (tsconfig.json). Every package checks its own.
//.ci: Runs the full gate: fmt, lint, the root type check, every package's check, guard and test scripts (each.ts runs them one package at a time and names every failure), then the UI build.
//.db:push: Pushes every module's tables straight into the database `bun run up` uses. It's at the root because starting without a database prints "run `bun run db:push` first".
//.db:generate: Generates the migration files of every package with a database schema, one package after the other. Every deployment applies them. .github/workflows/check-migrations.yml fails if they're out of date.
//.up: Starts @ryph/host from source: every module in one process, for local development.
//.playground: A whole ryph seeded with fixtures (a team, repos, history, live runs) and the app's dev server in front of it, for UI work; no container runtime needed. packages/playground.
//.agent-image: Builds the default agent image (the universal image, the harness layer, then ryph-agent, one on the other), the tool guard for hosted MCP servers, the egress proxy, the run gate and the browser, into docker's store; see images/agent/build.ts.
//.images:publish: Builds every image (services, the binary, the run images, the Radicle pair) for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 and pushes them to quay.io/ryph as the release's version (0.1.0 at a commit tagged v0.1.0, which gets sha-<commit> too) or sha-<commit>, then moves edge. The universal image is not rebuilt: its `1` digest gets the new tags, unless --build-universal (which makes every deployment rebuild its environments); --dry-run prints the plan and the buildx commands. Log in to quay.io first; see images/README.md.
//.build: Builds the shipping binary at dist/ryph, with the UI and schema inside; it needs nothing else installed to run. Builds the UI first, which a plain `bun build --compile` doesn't. Another platform's binary: packages/ryph's compile script.
//.release: Publishes this commit's `ryph` binaries for macOS and Linux, signed, to files.ryph.ai, where install.sh (packages/ryph/install.sh) fetches them. Publish the commit's images first (`images:publish`); `--dry-run` builds and signs without uploading. Only a tagged release (v0.1.0) moves `latest`. packages/ryph/scripts/release.ts.
//.release:version: Prints the version this checkout releases as (0.1.0 at a commit tagged v0.1.0, else sha-<commit>), or why a release would be refused; `--stamp 0.1.0` writes it into the Helm chart, to commit before tagging. packages/ryph/scripts/version.ts.
//.compose:*: The networked deployment, every service in its own container on this machine, with docker (deploy/compose-networked/). It pulls the published images by default; `compose:up` builds them from this checkout instead (deploy/compose-networked/compose.build.yaml). `compose:smoke` and `compose:e2e` need docker, so no check runs them: run `compose:e2e` by hand after changing the networked deployment.
//.compose:init: Writes any missing secret into deploy/compose-networked/.env (fresh random values, never replacing one), for deploy/compose-networked/compose.yaml, which has no defaults for them. `compose:up` and `perf:up` run it first.
//.compose:up: Builds what changed from this checkout (deploy/compose-networked/compose.build.yaml) and starts every service, waiting until all are healthy.
//.compose:stop: Stops the containers and keeps everything; `compose:up` brings them back.
//.compose:down: Removes the containers and networks, with the run gate, runs, check suites, hosted servers and build leftovers the launcher started for the stack. Keeps the data (database, object store, forge cache) and the images it pulled or built. Exits non-zero if anything could not be removed.
//.compose:reset: Removes the containers, networks, and data. Can't be undone.
//.compose:smoke: Checks that every service can reach the ones it talks to, over the real network.
//.perf:*: The perf harness (perf/README.md): the compose stack reshaped to production's CPU, database and pools, as its own project on its own networks so it never touches `compose:up`'s data. Its control plane launches nothing: the driver plays every runner.
//.perf:reset: Removes the perf stack's data too, seeded history included.
//.perf:load: Runs one scenario against it: `bun run perf:load --scenario burst`.
//.perf:seed: Fills it with years of history: `bun run perf:seed --runs 100000`.
//.perf:report: What the database did: `bun run perf:report`, `--reset` between scenarios.
//.k8s:smoke: Checks a Helm install (deploy/helm/smoke.ts): the app and the services behind it, then which addresses a run's and a check's pod can reach. `bun run k8s:smoke --kube-context <ctx>`; it needs a cluster, so it's not in `ci`.
//.k8s:refusals: The chart's refusals only a cluster can show (deploy/helm/refusals.ts): a changed or lost sealing key, a PriorityClass another release owns, a namespace-scoped installer. It briefly deletes and restores a Secret, from a backup on disk: `bun run k8s:refusals --kube-context <ctx> --throwaway=<ctx>`, and refuses unless <ctx> is a local kind or k3d cluster with a dev-state release.

scripts.ci: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run check && bun --no-env-file .ryph/each.ts check guard test && bun run --filter '@ryph/app' build
scripts.db:generate: bun run --filter '@ryph/orchestrator' db:generate && bun run --filter '@ryph/historian' db:generate && bun run --filter '@ryph/model-proxy' db:generate && bun run --filter '@ryph/mcp-gateway' db:generate && bun run --filter '@ryph/webhooks' db:generate && bun run --filter '@ryph/automations' db:generate && bun run --filter '@ryph/memory' db:generate && bun run --filter '@ryph/chat' db:generate && bun run --filter '@ryph/radicle' db:generate
scripts.compose:up: bun run compose:init && docker compose -f deploy/compose-networked/compose.yaml -f deploy/compose-networked/compose.build.yaml up -d --build --wait
scripts.compose:e2e: bun run compose:up && bun run compose:smoke
scripts.perf:up: bun run compose:init && docker compose -p ryph-perf -f deploy/compose-networked/compose.yaml -f deploy/compose-networked/compose.build.yaml -f perf/compose.perf.yaml up -d --build --wait
